_comment_layout: Copy this file to C:\PMDSync\config.json on the PC that runs the sync, fill in real values, and never commit it. Secrets (Epicor user/password) live in Windows Credential Manager — see docs/DEPLOYMENT.md section D.
_comment_output: Set OutputCsvPath to the OneDrive-synced PMD library so the CSV ends up in SharePoint automatically. Example for a synced 'PMD Documents' library: C:\Users\<you>\<Tenant>\<PMD site> - Documents\PMD\Planning.csv
